limitations: Shared candidate pools are per-case inputs, counted once, with two recorded model-score copies checked for agreement. Baseline absent discovery fields are not four independent failed pools.
Original booleans are frozen journal matcher outcomes. False means no recorded true match; per-paper unresolved identity denominator is not available from these booleans and remains unknown.
Assessed includes evidence entries that may be pending/excluded. Delivered, assessed, ranked and reviewed usable are distinct stages.
Exact recorded true-rank wins/ties/losses condition on both models hitting top10; ranks beyond10 are censored and not fabricated. One-sided Hit10 and neither-hit cases are separate.
Blind preference judges current supported usefulness and evidence. It can legitimately differ from historical-outlet rank comparison.

Candidate-level reviewed-eligible fractions require the actual candidate denominators in frozen ranking/card records. This scalar-only tool leaves them unknown; it does not read those scientific bodies.
Wilson interval overlap/nonoverlap and wins>=losses do not establish statistically significant or substantial improvement. This supplement changes neither test/scoring plan nor stable release gates.
